csv_scope_of_work: The Rio Grande Valley Emergency Communication District (RGV911) seeks to procure professional Architectural and Engineering (A/E) services for the planning, design, and construction support of a shelter facility to house the RGV911 Multi-Agency Communication Center (MACC) unit. short_description: Design services for a resilient shelter facility for an emergency mobile command unit.

services: Architectural and engineering services including architecture, interior design/space planning, civil engineering, structural engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, feasibility studies, site evaluation/selection, planning/master planning, and construction/project management support.
